title: q_max's narrow checks also run the comment-narration check on the changed files
why: Lane checks skip the narration check, so a batch refuses a lane late: batch 1107s refused #1101 and #974 over 77 narrating comments.
note: Run claude-settings lint/check_comment_narration.py --base origin/main in the narrow-check command, beside the STE lint.
